07.name: Grid Overvoltage
07.description: The grid voltage exceeds the acceptable range
solutions: Verify voltage protection settings in inverter
Contact grid operator if voltage persistently high

10.name: Grid Fault
solutions: Check all AC connections and cables

24.name: Grid Undervoltage
24.description: Grid voltage is below acceptable range
solutions: Check for voltage drops in main distribution

29.name: Isolation Fault
29.description: PV array isolation resistance too low
solutions: Check for water ingress in junction boxes
Check for ground faults in array

pv_fault.name: PV Input Fault
solutions: Inspect for shading or panel damage

temperature.name: Temperature Warning
solutions: Verify inverter not in direct sunlight
